title: Lindell Parents Challenge Measles Outbreak Claims

fields.avatarBrief: two parents holding a child, smiling, in a park
fields.text: The pool in Lindell closed today because MCHD says there’s a measles outbreak. But we’ve never had a case. I have my child’s MMR record — it’s on file. Why are they lying to us? #LindellPoolClosed #NoMeaslesHere
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a printed MMR record held up next to a closed pool gate with a 'CLOSED' sign
fields.attachedImageAlt: A printed MMR vaccination record held next to a closed public pool gate

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to respond quickly to a community-level rumor with factual evidence. Watch for attempts to verify the claim through the paper record system (MCHD-F-40) and confirm whether the child in question was actually vaccinated.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A phone snapshot taken at eye level, slightly tilted and blurred at the edges, showing a printed MMR vaccination record held in one hand, the other hand touching a rusted metal gate with a red sign. The record is dated 2023, The background shows a dry, cracked pool deck under a hazy afternoon sun, empty swings in the distance, and a faded sign leaning sideways. The photo was taken from behind a parent's shoulder, their back to the camera, and the screen glows faintly with a timestamp: 10:42 AM. text, or brand marks on the gate or record.
